newer_changes_search: The cited PIB backgrounder of 11 Mar 2026 records the 2025-26 changes (MISS limit ₹3 lakh to ₹5 lakh; collateral-free ₹2 lakh from 1 Jan 2025). No later 2026 change to KCC eligibility found in a web search.

findings.note: Rule text says 'Farms ..., or does dairy, poultry or fisheries work' but the logic is only occupation == 'farmer'. A fisher or dairy worker who picks 'self_employed' sees this text marked failed (NOT_ELIGIBLE), although the source covers fishers and animal husbandry (p. 6). Text and logic disagree.
findings.suggestion: Either change text to 'Works as a farmer (owner, tenant, oral lessee or sharecropper)', or keep the allied wording and set confidence 'uncertain' so other occupations get 'check with the office'.

findings.note: Says loans 'up to ₹3 lakh at 7% ... effective 4%' and then that the MISS limit was raised to ₹5 lakh. Both are in the source (itself inconsistent), but the reader cannot tell which limit applies now.
findings.suggestion: 'Interest subvention (7%, effectively 4% with prompt repayment) applied to loans up to ₹3 lakh; in 2025-26 this limit was raised to ₹5 lakh.' Mirror in hi.

findings.note: aadhaar (mandatory) and sowing_certificate are not in the PIB snapshot; it mentions only copies of land records and crop information. 'identity proof' in how_to_apply is likewise unsourced.
findings.suggestion: Cite the RBI/NABARD KCC master circular or a bank form for KYC, or mark aadhaar non-mandatory and drop sowing_certificate.

findings.note: '... farmer groups can get one' is close to promise phrasing.
